longForm.overview:

Where 🌍 reads as world-coded generic energy and 🏳️ reads as flag-coded universal energy, the Pakistan flag captures the moment when the sender wants to communicate Pakistani-coded energy - a "Pakistan pride" tag or a "Pakistan-coded" reveal.

The flag cue borrows from national tradition and the modern Pakistani-coded aesthetic, which is exactly why the emoji reads as Pakistani-coded rather than literal.

What separates the Pakistan flag from the rest of the flag family is the specific Pakistan register. The emoji is not saying 'flag in general' (🏳️) or 'rainbow-coded' (🏳️‍🌈). It is saying 'Pakistan,' which carries a specific national, cultural, and Pakistani-coded specificity.
